deduplication.definition: Primary deduplication uses immutable backend identity (dataset + stable sample_id) only; model-view equality is audit-only

determinism.comparison_basis: canonical logical row and core JSON content hashes; Parquet metadata and absolute output paths ignored

limitations: Exact and near Initial Model View collisions remain in Primary by design and are quantified by evaluation-clean sensitivity variants.
Primary class imbalance and legitimate repeated attack behavior are retained; future training-size control belongs to a separate reproducible sampler.
Edge attack classes are mostly single-capture, so no cross-attack-run generalization is claimed.
